verdict.rationale: Bitbucket docs explicitly claim merge checks, branch permissions, CI/CD policy enforcement, and even explicit 'automated change approval processes' tied to Jira Service Management for governance before production deployment. This directly matches the devops-lead governance story, though evidence is vendor-sourced only with no independent/hands-on corroboration of approval-gate enforcement in practice. Missing for 10: independent validation of approval workflow enforcement, detail on configuring multi-stage approval gates, and community confirmation of reliability.
